name: Entra Agent ID - Attack Scenarios (ATLAS)
description: MITRE ATLAS techniques mapped from the Entra Agent ID attack-scenario table. Load in the ATLAS Navigator (mitre-atlas.github.io/atlas-navigator). Generated 2026-09-18.

techniques.comment: Scenario 1: Privileges to gain control of Agent ID objects.
Scenarios 1 & 5. Application access token used against the downstream resource.
Scenario 2: Default ownership. createAsOwner is part of the default User role.
Scenario 2. Ownership is a standing grant surviving PIM deactivation / role removal.
Scenario 5. Operator expands inheritable permissions post-consent.
Scenario 5 (defender-side gap). Blueprint without a principal is invisible in the portal.
